session.name: Migrate billing API client to openapi-ts
session.name_lower: migrate billing api client to openapi-ts

prompts.text: Replace the hand-written fetch wrapper in src/api/billing with a client generated by openapi-ts from openapi.yaml. Keep the public function names so call sites don’t change, validate every response with Zod, and move the tests to Bun’s test runner. Run the full test suite before you finish and summarise anything you couldn’t migrate.
Use bun test, not vitest. Don’t add new dev dependencies.
Also update the README section on regenerating the client.
